summary.zh-CN: 以体验设计为核心，并连接落地、团队、产品盈利与更广语境的作者方法框架。
summary.en: An authorial method framework centered on experience design and connected to delivery, teams, product and profit, and broader contexts.

summary.zh-CN: 从体验旅程出发，确认感受、理解主观体验、解构客观原因，再选择设计杠杆重构目标体验。
summary.en: Start from the experience journey, confirm perception, understand subjective experience, deconstruct objective causes, and select design levers to reconstruct the intended experience.

summary.zh-CN: 解释如何通过问题解决、原型生产、证据迭代与交付取舍，把设计意图变成可交付结果。
summary.en: Explain how problem-solving, prototyping and production, evidence-led iteration, and delivery trade-offs turn design intent into a deliverable result.

summary.zh-CN: 在多人协作语境中处理愿景决策、对齐沟通、领导管理与反馈共识。
summary.en: Address vision and decisions, alignment and communication, leadership and management, and feedback and consensus in collaborative contexts.

name.zh-CN: 如果希望形成产品与盈利
name.en: If We Want Product and Profit

summary.zh-CN: 在产品与盈利目标存在时，处理受众定位、市场机会、价值交换及商业化与体验目标的协调。
summary.en: When product and profit are goals, address audience positioning, market opportunity, value exchange, and alignment between monetization and experience goals.

name.zh-CN: 如果讨论的不只是游戏

summary.zh-CN: 把价值观、伦理与文化纳入讨论，并以创新入口连接更大的可能性空间。
summary.en: Bring values, ethics, and culture into the discussion and connect through innovation to a larger possibility space.

summary.zh-CN: 把游戏过程理解为多个情绪体验构成的曲线。
summary.en: Understand the game process as a curve composed of multiple emotional experiences.

summary.zh-CN: 确认某种体验确实发生。
summary.en: Confirm that an experience actually occurs.

summary.zh-CN: 识别玩家的主观感受是什么。
summary.en: Identify the player's subjective experience.

summary.zh-CN: 理解产生体验的客观原因。
summary.en: Understand the objective causes that produce the experience.

summary.zh-CN: 在可能性空间中选择设计杠杆，重新把目标体验传达给玩家。
summary.en: Select design levers within the possibility space to communicate the intended experience to players again.

summary.zh-CN: 以叙事架构与叙事呈现作为实现体验目标的手段。
summary.en: Use narrative architecture and exposition as means to realize experience goals.

summary.zh-CN: 以美学方向与美学表达作为实现体验目标的手段。
summary.en: Use aesthetic direction and expression as means to realize experience goals.

summary.zh-CN: 以核心循环、规则系统、手感、节奏、关卡与空间作为实现体验目标的手段。
summary.en: Use core loops, rules and systems, game feel, pacing, levels, and space as means to realize experience goals.

name.zh-CN: 心态、问题解决与工具使用

summary.zh-CN: 以心态、问题解决与工具使用支持设计意图落地。
summary.en: Support the realization of design intent through mindset, problem-solving, and tool use.

summary.zh-CN: 通过原型、生产与任务拆解把设计意图转成可执行工作。
summary.en: Turn design intent into executable work through prototyping, production, and task breakdown.

summary.zh-CN: 通过 Playtest、证据分析与迭代检验并修正设计。
summary.en: Test and revise design through playtest, evidence analysis, and iteration.

summary.zh-CN: 通过取舍、规格与交付把设计意图形成可交付结果。
summary.en: Form a deliverable result from design intent through trade-offs, specification, and delivery.

summary.zh-CN: 在团队语境中持有愿景、明确创意方向并作出决策。
summary.en: Hold the vision, clarify creative direction, and make decisions in a team context.

summary.zh-CN: 在团队语境中处理对齐、沟通与可视化表达。
summary.en: Address alignment, communication, and visual expression in a team context.

summary.zh-CN: 在团队语境中通过领导与管理保障交付。
summary.en: Use leadership and management to assure delivery in a team context.

summary.zh-CN: 在团队语境中通过协作、反馈与共识促成共同工作。
summary.en: Enable shared work through collaboration, feedback, and consensus in a team context.

summary.zh-CN: 在产品与盈利目标存在时明确受众与定位。
summary.en: Clarify audience and positioning when product and profit are goals.

summary.zh-CN: 在产品与盈利目标存在时理解市场与未满足的体验。
summary.en: Understand the market and unmet experiences when product and profit are goals.

summary.zh-CN: 在产品与盈利目标存在时明确产品中的价值交换。
summary.en: Clarify value exchange within the product when product and profit are goals.

name.zh-CN: 商业化与体验目标协调

summary.zh-CN: 在产品与盈利目标存在时协调商业化与体验目标。
summary.en: Align monetization with experience goals when product and profit are goals.

summary.zh-CN: 把价值观、伦理与文化纳入对游戏的讨论。
summary.en: Bring values, ethics, and culture into the discussion of games.

name.zh-CN: 创新与更大的可能性空间
name.en: Innovation and a Larger Possibility Space

summary.zh-CN: 以创新创造或寻找更大的可能性空间，并连接 Innovation Atlas。
summary.en: Create or seek a larger possibility space through innovation and connect to the Innovation Atlas.
